pages.text: You start with a rifle - thirty in it - and a pistol, seventeen. $(bold)Rounds$() go in your pocket first: right-click a handful to pocket them, sneak to pocket the lot. $(bold)R$() reloads from the pocket.$(br)The soldiers and the scavengers carry both kinds; the rooms in town hold pistol rounds.$(br)$(bold)If you die$() you wake in the yard with the basic gear: both guns loaded, a little ammunition, the vest and helmet, a bandage, this notebook. What you carried lies where you fell.
